name: RGI-100-22
summary: RGI-100-22 is an electric rotary gripper that combines servo-controlled gripping with continuous rotation for test-tube opening, sample handling and industrial assembly. The 22 mm stroke and adjustable 30–100 N force per jaw accommodate small workpieces, while integrated drive and control provide position, force and rotation adjustment in one compact unit.

description.en: RGI-100-22 is an electric rotary gripper that combines servo-controlled gripping with continuous rotation for test-tube opening, sample handling and industrial assembly. The 22 mm stroke and adjustable 30–100 N force per jaw accommodate small workpieces, while integrated drive and control provide position, force and rotation adjustment in one compact unit.
